title: Authority of Scripture
definition: The authority of Scripture means that the Bible speaks with the authority of God Himself. Because Scripture is God's Word, it is the final standard for faith, doctrine, obedience, worship, and Christian living.
summary: The Bible is not merely a collection of religious writings or human opinions. God has spoken through Scripture, and His Word carries divine authority. Believers are called to submit to Scripture because it reveals God's truth and will for His people.
christFocus: Jesus consistently affirmed the authority of Scripture. He quoted it, obeyed it, fulfilled it, and taught from it. To honor Scripture is to honor the Lord who gave it.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God's Word is the final authority for what Christians believe and how Christians live. Human traditions, personal opinions, cultural trends, and spiritual experiences must always be tested by Scripture.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Without a final authority, believers are left to follow changing opinions and personal preferences. Scripture provides a stable foundation that does not change with culture or circumstances.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Read Scripture with humility and obedience. Test every teaching by God's Word. Ask not merely, "What do I think?" but "What has God said?"
